32.    OTHER BUSINESS:

       a) ORDINANCE —2” READING Amending Subsections 6.6.3.b.3, 6.7.5.c, and 6.9.3.e
                                            —



          of the Unified Development Code (UDC), changing the building façade design
          requirements for multifamily residential development. (RECONSIDERED &
          POSTPONED FROM DECEMBER Il, 2023)

Mr. Segrave moved to approve on 2” reading, seconded by Dr. Rinne. Mr. Segrave moved to
amend by substitute dated December 18, 2023, seconded by Dr. Rinne. Motion to amend carried
by unanimous voice vote. Main motion, as amended, carried by unanimous voice vote.
Seth Lloyd, Planning & Development Department Senior Planner, provided a staff report.
Committee members Laybourn, Rinne, and Segrave commented on the item. Public comments
were made by Mayor Patrick Collins; Dan Dorsch, Habitat for Humanity of Laramie County
Executive Director, and Vice Chair of the Affordable Housing Taskforce; Ansley Mouw, Winters
Griffith Architects; Jason Stephens, Gateway Construction; and Brandon Swain.
